llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide_index=2 (0-based), which corresponds to slide 3 as required by the instruction.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring fresh file state is read.
Getter collects all run-level colors (all_colors) and requires all runs to explicitly match #000000 (black), correctly verifying the color requirement.
Getter uses all(u is True for u in underlines) to check that every run is explicitly underlined, correctly verifying the underline requirement.

Metric correctly handles expected parameter as the rules dict directly (expected.type='rule'), using expected.get('expected_color_hex') and expected.get('expected_underline') without the erroneous .get('rules', {}) pattern.
Expected values (expected_color_hex='000000', expected_underline=true) precisely match the instruction requirements.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per criterion) is semantically appropriate for a two-requirement task.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Title detection uses topmost shape by position (shape.top) rather than checking for the title placeholder (ph_idx=0). In edge cases where another text box appears above the title placeholder, the wrong shape could be checked. Consider using python-pptx's slide.shapes.title or placeholder lookup as a primary method with positional fallback.
